'''Vesek''' was an [[Imperial Corrections Officer]] aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] Purge in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. He was part of the boarding party sent to scavenge for parts aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''Vector''. He unknowingly contracted the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing]] Virus and helped carry it back to the ''Purge''. He was sent to the infirmary aboard and died there.
